pr_title: Implement Marshal.GetIDispatchForObject on platforms with COM support

issue_context.title: Marshal.GetIDispatchForObject should be implemented on platforms with COM support
issue_context.body:
`Marshal.GetIDispatchForObject` always throws `PlatformNotSupportedException`. 

Now that we have COM support on Windows, it should actually be implemented under `FEATURE_COMINTEROP` and separate tests added for Windows / non-Windows - just like the other COM-related `Marshal` functions.

Callers achieving the same functionality through `Marshal.GetComInterfaceForObject` with `IDispatch` as the type could be switched to it as well - https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/33060#discussion_r387847964
